summary: The trace shows the agent successfully filled an HWPX template but had to write inline Python for data pre-processing (Korean age calculation, phone normalization) before using the template-filling logic. The existing skill covers the core HWPX mechanics but lacks guidance on common data transformations required before filling. This update adds a pre-processing step to the workflow and a reference document with reusable Korean-specific transformation patterns (만 나이 age calculation, phone normalization) so future agents know to transform data before calling fill_hwpx.py.
